verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping service with client software, so chart-of-accounts customization is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only automated transaction categorization, categorization rules, and reports. Nothing documents customer-editable account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions. The banking 'dedicated accounts' are bank sub-accounts, not ledger accounts. QBO-native work happens in the host platform's chart of accounts, not Bench's own capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
